title: OpenReading Leaderboard Report v0.2
description: The output of `evals.leaderboard.run_leaderboard` (BL-160): the SAME evals.dataset case.json corpus run through the unchanged evals.runner.run_case path across N registered backends, ranked by measured mean score on that one dataset. Backends are ranked best-first; each row carries its measured score, per-dimension breakdown, error tally and determinism flag together. `dataset` names the exact corpus that produced this ranking (path, case count, case names) so two reports are never structurally mistakable for having run the same cases. schema_version is a per-version const. v0.2 adds the optional per-backend criticality fields, which a case's `x-read-criticality` labels produce and which never enter mean_score or dimensions.

backends.description: One row per benchmarked backend, sorted best-first (rank 1 = highest mean_score).

cases.description: One row per dataset case, in dataset order, with every backend's score on that case and the per-case winner.

path.description: The dataset directory this report ran.

mean_score.description: DatasetReport.mean_overall on this dataset — errored/unscored cases excluded from both numerator and denominator, never folded in as a fabricated 0.0 (see n_cases/n_scored/errors for provenance).

n_scored.description: Of n_cases, how many carried a recognized `expected` dimension AND ran without error — mean_score is grounded in this subset only.

non_deterministic.description: True when backend_id is a member of comparison.report._NON_DETERMINISTIC — mean_score is then a single labeled sample, never trusted as exactly reproducible run-to-run.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension mean (the scorers.score() headline value — a dict-shaped dimension's f1, else the plain float) over the cases that exercised that dimension. Never blended into one cross-dimension number.

weighted_f1.description: Mean of the case-level criticality.weighted_prf.f1 over the cases without error that produced one. Absent when no case's schema carried an x-read-criticality label. It sits beside mean_score and never feeds it, so a weighted number cannot hide an unweighted regression.

critical_pass_rate.description: Fraction of the n_critical_scored cases whose critical fields were all right (criticality.critical_pass of 1.0). Absent when n_critical_scored is 0.

n_critical_scored.description: How many cases without error had at least one critical field in their gold record. critical_pass_rate rests on this count.

weights_version.description: The criticality weight-table version the cases were scored with, such as "v1" (openreading.evals.scorers.CRITICALITY_WEIGHTS_V1). Absent when no case was scored by criticality.

winner.description: The backend_id with the highest score on this case (ties broken alphabetically); absent/null when no backend produced a real score.

scores.description: backend_id -> that backend's overall on this case; null when errored or unscored (never a fabricated 0.0).
